question: Under what temporal condition is it claimed that old age and death are destroyed?
premises: A duration of one year is specified.
A condition of having practiced is given.
Under that condition, old age and death are said to be destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The practice referred to is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
